item.title: One Day For Salvation
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Abbys_Cat
  • 発売日: 2024-03-29
  • スコア: なし (2 人評価)
  • 日本語名: One Day For Salvation
  • 英語名: 无

あらすじ

The “MC” is walking down an alley late at night when he is attacked and kidnapped by an entity that throws him into a dungeon. It’s up to the player to find ways to escape from their cell and get out of that place, passing through various strange and intriguing landscapes and encountering various girls and bizarre beings.
